_note: Prior-league output for players in the FPL data who have no/limited PL history — promoted-club players (from the Championship) and new signings from abroad. Gives them a real projection + info instead of a flat FPL price. 'proj' overrides the auto estimate (use it for foreign leagues, which translate differently than the Championship). Matched by web_name + club. Season: 2026/27.
